audience: a parent or patient-group leader without medical training

sentences.text: Two conditions, GM1 gangliosidosis type 2 and mucopolysaccharidosis type 4B, are both recorded as caused by the gene GLB1 [e_ad327e2ac535] [e_ebcdbdec8f81].
Both gene links are curated, meaning they come from OMIM and Orphanet [e_ad327e2ac535] [e_ebcdbdec8f81].
Constellate computed that the two conditions share this causal gene, at confidence 0.95 [e_bf9e4c9393d5].
That shared-gene link is inferred, meaning it was calculated and is not a separate database finding [e_bf9e4c9393d5].
For GM1 gangliosidosis type 2, two observed features are recorded, loss of motor skills and small vertebral bodies, each from a single report [e_d3bff9fbde9c] [e_db4a1049ed53].
An enlarged spleen is listed for this condition but marked as contradicted [e_92c0e3ba4f84].

These edges do not show how one gene gives rise to two different conditions, and they list no symptoms for mucopolysaccharidosis type 4B, no studies and no treatments [e_bf9e4c9393d5] [e_ebcdbdec8f81].
